Helping You and Your Horse Succeed through Equine Massage Therapy and Dressage Training.
Willing to Travel to You ~ Currently Serving Indian River, Brevard, Osceola, Palm Beach Counties in Florida, and beyond!
I am certified through Equissage and Animal Dynamics, and I have been training horses in Dressage since 2009. 

Connect with me through my LinkTree⬇️

https://linktr.ee/melsequestrianservices
